en.answer: When either monster battles, since their effects that prevent the opponent from activating effects are applied, even if you activate effects during the Battle or Damage Step, the opponent cannot activate effects in a chain.
en.question: Can the opponent activate card effects in a chain to the activation of your card effects during the Battle Step or Damage Step in which <<11717>> or <<11718>> battle?
en.title: Can the opponent activate card effects in a chain to the activation of your card effects during the Battle Step or Damage Step in which <<11717>> or <<11718>> battle?

ja.answer: 「<<11718>>」や「<<11717>>」が戦闘を行う場合、『①：このカードが戦闘を行う場合、相手はダメージステップ終了時まで魔法・罠・モンスターの効果を発動できない』効果が適用されていますので、そのバトルステップやダメージステップにて自分がカードの効果を発動した場合でも、相手はチェーンしてカードの効果を発動する事はできません。
